notes.content:
Change the formula for extortion in prisons.
Fixed a bug that prevented achievements from opening.

Fixed a bug that caused an error when entering certain MAPs online
Fixed a bug that prevented certain events from starting properly.
Fixed a bug where playing roulette would make your friends opaque

Fixed a bug that prevented some skins from being reflected in En/Ru.
Corrected MAP information

Fixed transparent background of some letters
Changed to accept casino coins at the factory
Changed the appearance time of drop items in the prison from 60 seconds to 5 seconds because they can be obtained repeatedly
Change in the number of birds in the prison
Addition of MAP
Reinforcement of events when Kasumi and Grave Child are not encountered.

Changed font for Korean 
Changed font for Russian.

Slightly increased the accuracy of translation
Added Korean language
Added Russian

Changed so that it works even if the window is inactive.
Changed to continue working with off-screen events.
Added casino (moved from yellow rabbit).
Implemented substance summoner.

Added 100,000 and 1,000,000 rates to slots.
Changed the slot UI.
Changed the probability of slots.
Fixed flickering of some graphics.
Added an event about Buzama.
Added a skin that can only be used if you have purchased the DLC_soundtrack.
Changed so that sleep effects appear when left unattended for a certain amount of time.
Changed so that you can see which users are connected. (In the bottom left corner of the large chat window)


Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

Changed the chat character limit to 65 characters
Impure soul collectors are now available at the factory.
The amount of collectible devices obtained when opening a box now increases with game progress
Changed the system for the rate of increase in the intervention of the prison forces (limited to twice the number of the two other forces combined) (unlocked with 1,000,000 sensitivity of the red bird)

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

Fixed a bug regarding movement using W, A, S, and D.
Removed some uncomfortable dialogues.
Removed the hidden status of unopened achievements.
Adjusted battle balance.
Changed so that the SteamName is displayed when the game is launched for the first time.
Added Steam Achievements.

Changed the function of presenting a bouquet of flowers
Changed the rendering method to be variable.

Changed nausea value to decrease slowly in white room
Fixed a bug that caused an error in hallucinations
Changed the text in the identity change box
Fixed a bug where formalin-soaked bugs were always in Notepad.
Improved the display of some text.
Improved the prison system in general.
Added some songs to Chisui Live
Changed the function of resetting boredom at home to apply to all players online.
Some adjustments to the price of begging points.
Added events to Master Mu's errand.
Updated NW.js.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

Changed the items available from collectors.
Changed items that can be purchased from the blue rabbit.
Changed items that can be purchased from the red rabbit for a loan.
Changed Chisui Battle rewards.
Increased the item drop rate for prison birds.
Changed items for sale in prison.
Changed the cost of the machine that controls boredom in your home from 10,000,000 to 1,000,000.
Improved teleporter hit detection.
Added Chinese language support.

Changes to some events
Added identity
Changed the decrease value of medicine from -20 to -50.
Fixed a bug related to display.
Changed so that the appearance can be restored after being changed in Yoncy.
Fixed bug that some boredom is not reset.
Changed so that house sale charisma disappears.
Fixed a bug where an error would occur while using medicine.
Fixed a bug where a message is displayed from an unintended location.
Fixed a bug where Chisui Bromide was not displayed correctly
Changed the nausea value to be lowered in some areas
Changed the initial name handling

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

Fixed a bug where location sharing didn't work.
Added an event to Yoncy Favorability 1000.

No longer consumes items in a state of boredom.
Made the random movement of MAP somewhat constant.
Changed the number of seasonings that can be purchased in the prison.
Changed some achievements.
Changed the Kusaribana Purifier to automatically process.
Changed so that the junk delivery degree can be checked in the notepad.
